headings.title: Offense of peace disturbance
headings.reviewNote: Defines peace disturbance through unreasonable noise, face-to-face offensive language, threats of felonious acts, fighting, odor, or obstruction.

headings.title: Penalty classifications for repeat convictions
headings.reviewNote: Classifies peace disturbance as a class B misdemeanor for first conviction, class A misdemeanor for second or subsequent conviction, with mandatory $1,000 to $5,000 fine upon third or subsequent conviction.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified against archived text and 1987 State v. Carpenter annotation on subsection 1(1)(c); clarified second-or-subsequent misdemeanor and third-or-subsequent mandatory fine in subsection 2 note.

headings.title: Offense of private peace disturbance
headings.reviewNote: Defines private peace disturbance on private property by purposely causing alarm through fighting or threatening offenses.

headings.title: Penalty classification
headings.reviewNote: Designates private peace disturbance as a class C misdemeanor.

headings.title: Separately occupied units as separate premises
headings.reviewNote: Deems separately occupied units within a building or structure to be separate premises.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified verbatim against archived text (effective 1-01-17).

headings.title: Title of act
headings.reviewNote: Cites section as the House of Worship Protection Act.

headings.title: Definition of house of worship
headings.reviewNote: Defines house of worship as places or structures used for religious worship, instruction, or religious purpose.

headings.title: Offense of disrupting a house of worship
headings.reviewNote: Defines disruption through disturbing noise, profane discourse, rude behavior, or interference with religious freedom.

headings.title: Penalty classifications for repeat offenses
headings.reviewNote: Classifies house of worship disruption as a class B misdemeanor, class A misdemeanor for a second offense, and class E felony for any third or subsequent offense.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified against archived text (House of Worship Protection Act) and 2013/2015 First Amendment case annotations (SNAP v. Joyce); clarified third-or-subsequent felony tier in subsection 4 note.

headings.title: Offense of unlawful assembly
headings.reviewNote: Defines unlawful assembly when knowingly assembling with six or more persons and agreeing to violate criminal laws with force or violence.

headings.title: Penalty classification
headings.reviewNote: Designates unlawful assembly as a class B misdemeanor.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified verbatim against archived text (effective 1-01-17).

headings.title: Offense of refusal to disperse
headings.reviewNote: Defines refusal to disperse when failing to obey a lawful command to depart from an unlawful assembly or riot.

headings.title: Penalty classification
headings.reviewNote: Designates refusal to disperse as a class C misdemeanor.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified verbatim against archived text (effective 1-01-17).

headings.title: Definitions
headings.reviewNote: Defines civil disorder, explosive or incendiary device, firearm, and law enforcement officer.

headings.title: Offense of promoting civil disorder
headings.reviewNote: Defines promoting civil disorder by teaching or demonstrating firearms, explosives, or incendiary devices knowing or intending their use in furtherance of a civil disorder.

headings.title: Penalty classification
headings.reviewNote: Designates promoting civil disorder as a class D felony.

headings.title: Exemption for lawful weapon training
headings.reviewNote: Exempts weapon training for law enforcement, hunting, recreation, competition, or other lawful activities.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 4 subsections against archived text; added 'knowing or intending' to subsection 2 note.

headings.title: Offense of drinking or drunkenness in prohibited places
headings.reviewNote: Defines entering a schoolhouse or church house with a lawful assemblage, or any courthouse, in an intoxicated and disorderly condition, or drinking or offering to drink intoxicating liquors there.

headings.title: Penalty classification
headings.reviewNote: Designates drunkenness or drinking in a prohibited place as a class B misdemeanor.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified against archived text; aligned subsection 1 note with 'intoxicated and disorderly condition' wording.

headings.title: Offense of causing catastrophe
headings.reviewNote: Defines causing catastrophe by explosion, fire, flood, building collapse, or release of dangerous substances or agents.

headings.title: Definitions of catastrophe and vital public facility
headings.reviewNote: Defines catastrophe based on casualties or property destruction and defines vital public facility.

headings.title: Penalty classification
headings.reviewNote: Designates causing catastrophe as a class A felony.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified verbatim against archived text; formerly section 569.070 (transferred 2014).

headings.title: Offense of institutional vandalism
headings.reviewNote: Defines institutional vandalism targeting places of worship, cemeteries, religious schools, school buses, or public monuments.

headings.title: Penalty classifications based on property damage
headings.reviewNote: Classifies institutional vandalism as a class A misdemeanor, class E felony for $750 or more, or class D felony exceeding $5,000.

headings.title: Determination of property damage
headings.reviewNote: Specifies that property damage includes repair costs or necessary replacement costs.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified verbatim against archived text (2021 amendment).

headings.title: Definitions for money laundering
headings.reviewNote: Defines conducts, criminal activity, cryptocurrency, financial transaction, monetary instruments, person, and transaction.

headings.title: Offense of money laundering
headings.reviewNote: Defines money laundering by conducting financial transactions to promote crimes, disguise proceeds, evade reporting, or further terrorism.

headings.title: Penalty classification and monetary fine
headings.reviewNote: Designates money laundering as a class B felony and permits assessing an additional fine up to $500,000 or twice the transaction amount, whichever is greater.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 3 subsections against archived text (2022 cryptocurrency/blockchain amendment); preserved permissive 'may be assessed' in subsection 3 note.

headings.title: Offense of using laser pointer against officers
headings.reviewNote: Defines using a laser pointer by knowingly directing light at a uniformed safety officer, peace officer, firefighter, or medic.

headings.title: Definition of laser pointer
headings.reviewNote: Defines laser pointer as a device emitting visible light amplified by stimulated emission of radiation.

headings.title: Penalty classification
headings.reviewNote: Designates using a laser pointer as a class A misdemeanor.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified verbatim against archived text (L. 2021 S.B. 53 & 60).

headings.title: Offense of terrorist threat in the first degree
headings.reviewNote: Defines first-degree terrorist threat by communicating life-threatening conditions or false reports to frighten ten people or cause evacuations.

headings.title: Penalty classification
headings.reviewNote: Designates making a terrorist threat in the first degree as a class D felony.

headings.title: Good faith exception to prevent harm
headings.reviewNote: Exempts persons acting in good faith with the purpose to prevent harm.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified verbatim against archived text (effective 1-01-17).

headings.title: Offense of terrorist threat in the second degree
headings.reviewNote: Defines second-degree terrorist threat by recklessly disregarding evacuation or closure risks and communicating threats or false reports.

headings.title: Penalty classification
headings.reviewNote: Designates making a terrorist threat in the second degree as a class E felony.

headings.title: Good faith exception to prevent harm
headings.reviewNote: Exempts persons acting in good faith with the purpose to prevent harm.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified verbatim against archived text (effective 1-01-17).

headings.title: Offense of terrorist threat in the third degree
headings.reviewNote: Defines third-degree terrorist threat by communicating threats or false reports with criminal negligence regarding evacuation risks.

headings.title: Penalty classification
headings.reviewNote: Designates making a terrorist threat in the third degree as a class A misdemeanor.

headings.title: Good faith exception to prevent harm
headings.reviewNote: Exempts persons acting in good faith with the purpose to prevent harm.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified verbatim against archived text (effective 1-01-17).

headings.title: Offense of agroterrorism
headings.reviewNote: Defines agroterrorism by purposely spreading contagious, communicable, or infectious diseases among crops, poultry, or livestock.

headings.title: Penalty classifications based on damage amount
headings.reviewNote: Designates agroterrorism as a class E felony, elevated to class B felony if damage is ten million dollars or more.

headings.title: Defense for medical or research activities
headings.reviewNote: Provides a defense for medically recognized therapeutic procedures or legitimate scientific research.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified against archived text (formerly section 578.008); corrected subsection 3 heading from 'Affirmative defense' to statutory 'Defense'.

headings.title: Offense of cross burning
headings.reviewNote: Defines cross burning with the purpose to frighten, intimidate, or cause emotional distress.

headings.title: Penalty classification
headings.reviewNote: Designates cross burning as a class A misdemeanor, elevated to class E felony for repeat offenses.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified verbatim against archived text; formerly section 565.095 (transferred 2014).

headings.title: Offense of unlawful funeral protest
headings.reviewNote: Defines unlawful funeral protest by picketing within three hundred feet of a funeral or burial service during or within one hour thereof.

headings.title: Definition of other protest activities
headings.reviewNote: Defines other protest activities as disruptive actions undertaken to disturb funeral or burial services.

headings.title: Definitions of funeral and burial service with transit exemption
headings.reviewNote: Defines funeral and burial service and exempts funeral processions in transit beyond the three-hundred-foot zone.

headings.title: Penalty classification
headings.reviewNote: Designates unlawful funeral protest as a class B misdemeanor, elevated to class A misdemeanor for repeat offenses.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified verbatim against archived text (L. 2014 H.B. 1231 merged with H.B. 1372).

headings.title: Offense of interference with medical assistance
headings.reviewNote: Defines interference with medical assistance by abortion facility employees directing deviation or blocking standard care.

headings.title: Penalty classification
headings.reviewNote: Designates interference with medical assistance as a class A misdemeanor.

headings.title: Definition of medical personnel
headings.reviewNote: Defines medical personnel to include physicians, nurses, EMS personnel, and supervised personnel.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified verbatim against archived text (effective 10-24-17).

headings.title: Offense of interference with health care facility
headings.reviewNote: Defines interference with a health care facility by peace disturbance, refusing to vacate, or threats, exempting mental health patients.

headings.title: Hospital workplace violence policies
headings.reviewNote: Mandates hospital workplace violence policies and prohibits retaliation against employees seeking emergency assistance.

headings.title: Penalty classifications
headings.reviewNote: Designates interference with a health care facility as a class D misdemeanor, elevated to class C misdemeanor for repeat offenses.

headings.title: Definition of health care facility
headings.reviewNote: Defines health care facility as a hospital providing health care services directly to patients.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 4 subsections against archived text (L. 2021 S.B. 26 merged with S.B. 53 & 60).

headings.title: Offense of interference with ambulance service
headings.reviewNote: Defines interference with ambulance service by obstructing access, disrupting services, or threatening personnel or vehicles.

headings.title: Penalty classifications
headings.reviewNote: Designates interference with an ambulance service as a class D misdemeanor, elevated to class C misdemeanor for repeat offenses.

headings.title: Definition of ambulance service
headings.reviewNote: Defines ambulance service as an entity providing emergency or nonemergency ambulance transportation and services.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified verbatim against archived text (L. 2021 S.B. 26).

headings.title: Offense of interference with a first responder
headings.reviewNote: Defines interference with a first responder when knowingly and willfully violating a verbal warning and approaching within twenty feet with intent to impede legal duty, threaten physical harm, or engage in a course of conduct serving no legitimate purpose.

headings.title: Penalty classifications
headings.reviewNote: Designates interference with a first responder as a class B misdemeanor, elevated to class A misdemeanor for repeat offenses.

headings.title: Definitions of first responder and personnel types
headings.reviewNote: Defines first responder, firefighter, paramedic, and emergency medical technicians.

headings.title: Protection of First Amendment and recording rights
headings.reviewNote: Protects First Amendment rights and guarantees the right to observe or record first responders.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 4 subsections against archived text (L. 2025 H.B. 225); replaced unstated 'harass' in subsection 1 note with statutory 'course of conduct serving no legitimate purpose'.
